turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Take the zero off, and put the apology in an email to me and the principal.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? A teammate would have picked up the phone before entering a zero. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen first.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology in writing to me and the principal, and a straight answer on whether Owen was heard before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and an answer on whether Owen was heard first.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "on the same team", because flattery and team talk read to her as being managed, and she answered it with a sharper demand.
Try next time: when she first asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then put a dated document about Owen's own work in front of her.
